## Where the world's most complex supply chains do their thinking.

### Unified Architecture & True Partnership

Network design built for the speed and seasonality of retail.

$50B+ USD

Supply Chain Leader

### Data to decision

Analytics and optimization in one place, for the people closest to the data.

$500M+ USD

Supply Chain Analytics Manager

### The All-in-One Platform

Planning that adapts as fast as a consumer-goods supply chain changes.

$1B+ USD

Supply chain planning fast enough to keep a consumer-goods operation moving.

$25B+ USD

### Touch less, ship more

With Lyric we touch the fewest orders, ship the most product, and protect our commitments.

Senior Director

Tens of millions cheaper this year than last, purely from how we use our data.

Director

The power of mathematics, finally in the hands of the people who run the business.

Our data and our modeling finally live in one place. That was the difference-maker.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a455ce597623f0a8ccc7579/6a6315e4a7c3e824760aaf6b_Coca-cola.svg)

Senior Director

A decision that used to take two weeks now takes ten minutes.
